messages.content: How to open price chart in openbb cli

To open a price chart in the OpenBB CLI, you first need to start the OpenBB terminal. From your command line, you can start it by running `openbb`.

Once you are in the OpenBB terminal, you can use the following command structure to load a stock and display its candle chart:

```
/stocks/load <TICKER>/candle
```

For example, to see a chart for the ticker `MSFT`, you would run the following:

```
/stocks/load MSFT/candle
```

You can also add moving averages to the chart with the `--ma` flag:

```
/stocks/load MSFT/candle --ma 50,150
```

To get help on any command, you can append `-h` to the command. For example:

```
/stocks/candle -h
```
